# Getting help with Codewhale

- **A question about using Codewhale:** ask in
  [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/discussions/categories/q-a)
  or on [Discord](https://discord.gg/37gfS3ksug). The
  [user guide](../docs/GUIDE.md) and the [documentation index](../docs/README.md)
  answer many questions already.
- **A bug, a crash or behavior that surprised you:** open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
  `codewhale doctor` prints the version and setup details a report needs.
- **An idea or feedback:** open an
  [issue](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/issues/new/choose), or talk it
  through first in
  [Ideas](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/discussions/categories/ideas).
- **A security problem:** report it privately as described in the
  [security policy](SECURITY.md), never in a public issue.

The [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) explains where each kind of help
goes and how a pull request lands.
